guidance: We might go to 11%, 12%, but the volumes have increased and with Ecosis coming in place, steam project coming in place, everything, this will help us in surpassing that target as a total number.
And now the targets for using a certain amount of T2T polyester content in apparel sold in Europe, those targets are being set and should take another 12 months.
capex: Let me now update you on our comprehensive capex program of approximately INR690 crores, which is now in its final stage.
Our INR235 crores expansion at Dahej will add approximately 55,000 tons of annual capacity across POY, FDY and DTY with an emphasis on higher-value products.
risks: Falling prices put greater pressure on manufacturers as selling prices come under immediate pressure while higher cost inventories take time to work through.
This was achieved despite volatility in petrochemical feedstock prices, elevated energy costs and geopolitical uncertainties.
focus: We are also focused on ensuring that our ongoing investment translate into sustainable operating and financial performance.
But now for the new customer, what is happening is they will make a visit to the plant, do audit, which will take 2 to 3 weeks.
So do trials because we were also learning, this was new production for us.
